How the Verification Gate Works
Points are held in Pending status immediately after a report is submitted. A Sentinels Liaison or Security officer reviews each submission for accuracy and actionability. Once approved, points are released to your Available balance and become redeemable for vouchers. Rejected reports are removed from the queue with no points awarded.
